or Sāṃkhyasaptati. in 70 v.. by Īśvarakṛṣṇa (300 C.E.). For a. elaborate study in comparison to its Chinese verson by Paramartha, See J. Takokusu, La Sāṅkhyakārikā, etudiee a. la lumiere de sa version Chinoise, BEFEO. IV. 1904, p.. 1-65. 978-1064.
